title: PCEP: Add support for TE-PATH-BINDING TLV
description:
This is described in RFC 9604.

See https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc9604#section-4

This TLV is part of the LSP object.

Example output for 4 different instances:
```
TE-PATH-BINDING
    Type: TE-PATH-BINDING (55)
    Length: 7
    Binding Type (BT): MPLS label value (0)
    Flags: 0x00
        0... .... = Removal (R): Not set
        .000 0000 = Reserved: Not set
    Reserved: 0x0000
    Binding SID, Label: 965537
        1110 1011 1011 1010 0001 .... .... .... = Label: 965537
    Padding: 00
TE-PATH-BINDING
    Type: TE-PATH-BINDING (55)
    Length: 8
    Binding Type (BT): MPLS label stack entry (1)
    Flags: 0x80, Removal (R)
        1... .... = Removal (R): Set
        .000 0000 = Reserved: Not set
    Reserved: 0x0000
    Binding SID, Label: 100704, TC: 0, S: 1, TTL: 1
        0001 1000 1001 0110 0000 .... .... .... = Label: 100704
        .... .... .... .... .... 000. .... .... = TC: 0
        .... .... .... .... .... ...1 .... .... = Bottom of Stack (S): 1
        .... .... .... .... .... .... 0000 0001 = TTL: 1
TE-PATH-BINDING
    Type: TE-PATH-BINDING (55)
    Length: 20
    Binding Type (BT): SRv6 SID (2)
    Flags: 0x00
        0... .... = Removal (R): Not set
        .000 0000 = Reserved: Not set
    Reserved: 0x0000
    Binding SID
        Value: 18960101010101010101010101010101
TE-PATH-BINDING
    Type: TE-PATH-BINDING (55)
    Length: 4
    Binding Type (BT): MPLS label value (0)
    Flags: 0x00
        0... .... = Removal (R): Not set
        .000 0000 = Reserved: Not set
    Reserved: 0x0000
```
